This really belongs in an IBM i specific collection- we're not generally adding support for new platforms to the core facts modules since they can be configured and invoked automatically via inventory when gather_facts or the `setup` module is run (eg, `ansible_facts_modules=yourns.yourcoll.yourfactmodule`).
